Toughpower GF3 850W Gold (2025 Version)
 – Thermaltake USA

80 PLUS Gold certified fully modular power supply with PCIe Gen5.1 native connector, high amperage +12V rail, advanced DC-DC & LLC design, Japanese capacitors, and industry-grade protections optimized for next-gen GPUs and ATX 3.1 systems.

Next-Gen Ready with ATX 3.1 & PCIe Gen5.1

Built to meet Intel ATX 3.1 power supply requirements and
            equipped with a native 12+4pin PCIe Gen5.1 modular connector
            to support next-generation GPUs.

1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power
            demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific
            components, usage, and many other factors.

2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the
            GPU manufactures before using the 12VHPWR cable.

All main capacitors are high-quality Japanese-made for
            long-lasting reliability and stability under heavy loads.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & DC-DC + LLC Design

Provides stable and powerful +12V output with precise voltage
            regulation for high-performance systems.

High efficiency Zero Cable platform with low-profile flat
            cables improves airflow and cable management.

Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP),
            Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP),
            Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection
            (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguard your
            system against electrical faults, providing peace of mind and
            reliable operation.

Delivers up to 90% power conversion efficiency under
            real-world load conditions, reducing wasted energy and heat.

Supports Intel Deep Power Down C6/C7 states, ErP ready, and
            complies with Energy Star, RoHS, and WEEE standards.
